results.answer: The supplier guarantees that the supplier will have a right to dispose of the property in the goods when that property is to pass to the consumer. results.answer: Yes, prior written notice can affect the spare parts guarantee. evidence.text: 271 Action for damages against manufacturers of goods 1 If: a the guarantee under section 54 applies to a supply of goods to a consumer; and b the guarantee is not complied with; an affected person in relation to the goods may, by action against the manufacturer of the goods, recover damages from the manufacturer. 2 Subsection (1) does not apply if the guarantee under section 54 is not complied with only because of: a an act, default or omission of, or any representation made by, any person other than the manufacturer or an employee or agent of the manufacturer;
